newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PLDT to cut staff by 350 in the second half.
newsitem.headline: PLDT to cut staff by 350 in the second half.

text.p: The Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co said on Monday it will reduce its workforce by 300 to 350 in the second half of the year.
"We expect some 300 to 350 employees to avail of the redundancy programme by year-end," said PLDT senior vice-president Antonio Samson in an analysts briefing.
PLDT executive vice-president Edgardo Del Fonso said the firm's total workforce was cut by 2,470 to 15,803 in the first half of the year.
The PLDT officials said the 300 to 350 employees are part of the 1,000 more who are likely to avail of the redundancy programme. They did not say when the remaining number will leave the firm.
Del Fonso said the company has booked 585 million pesos for redundancy costs for the first six months of the year.
The company has initiated a redundancy programme since 1995 under which a total of 3,431 employees have left the company.
